requirements.name: Peek single camera
blockers: Desktop focus quality and diagnostics exist, but no separately authored Paper implementation frame owns a player-settings popover.

requirements.name: Layout editor
blockers: Drag, resize, snap, presets, pinning, Activity Focus draft state, and discard work; server layout persistence and CRUD are unavailable.

requirements.name: Keep stories
blockers: Event persistence returns one optional thumbnail and no narrative, publisher identity, or multi-frame attachment sequence.

requirements.name: Keep export range
blockers: Export jobs and editable ranges work over WebRTC, but exact keyframe positions are not returned for a visible snapped-handle claim.

requirements.name: Events detail
blockers: Payload, revision history, publisher source_id, narrative, and attachment history are absent from the current event record.

requirements.name: Add camera wizard
blockers: Candidate authentication and decoded stream probing do not exist before the final configuration write.

requirements.name: Camera list and per-camera page
blockers: Fleet and camera evidence exist, but server layout/group provenance, per-camera retention inheritance, and broad settings writes are unavailable.

requirements.name: Storage and retention
blockers: Projected capacity exists, while observed oldest-footage history, selectable fill policy, per-camera retention, pins, and offsite locations do not.

requirements.name: Event sources
blockers: Publisher registration, token/scopes, mapping, heartbeat, and publication-runtime contracts are unavailable.

requirements.name: Server and client health
blockers: Current server, storage, camera, and WebRTC evidence exists; long-window loss, exact gap start, retries, probes, and external-service liveness do not.

requirements.name: Access roles and permissions
blockers: The target two-role policy is visible, but identity enforcement, people, sessions, invitations, token scopes, and audit evidence are unavailable.

constraints: KeepPeek ingests detections and does not provide detector training, enrollment, zone, mask, or tripwire editors.
The primary Keep timeline remains vertical at every breakpoint.

Application controls use canonical WebRTC commands; public HTTP adds only the protobuf-defined backup recovery API to create, delete, logs, and metrics, with recording coverage reserved for the first-party UI.
Recording stays visually quiet and red is reserved for failure.
One camera page owns its stacked configuration sections.
